title: pilosella officinarum subsp. velutina
intro: Pilosella officinarum subsp. velutina, commonly known as False Sow Thistle or Velvet Sow Thistle, is a subspecies of plant in the Asteraceae family. It has been used for centuries in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella officinarum subsp. velutina include its ability to reduce inflammation, ease digestive issues, and support wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
